datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule across Mali in 2022. The classifications were spatially mapped to geographic units and stored in GeoJSON and KML formats with metadata including collection dates, scenarios, and classification scales to represent current food insecurity situations.
